Visually confirmed at full native resolution: recto (page 1) is an ordinary Latin letter, "Hamburgi" dateline, no cipher content; verso/address side (page 2) carries, rotated 90 degrees at top left, at least two distinct plaintext-alphabet-to-cipher-alphabet key rows (e.g. "aliderfgsikln" over what reads as a mixed run, and a second shorter row below it) beside the address block and wax seal -- key material only, no obviously enciphered running-text block spotted at this pass (not transcribed, not decoded, per brief).
